label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - written for training/reference, not a real project or request.
weak_brief: Make a cool tarot app with everything: readings, astrology charts, marketplace, community, AI readings, login with Google, and deploy it.
why_it_fails: No first slice: the whole vision is in scope.
Needs auth, AI keys and a server the VM can't verify.
Asks for a deploy with no review.
No design direction, mockups, tests or screenshot loop.
No isolation: doesn't say where to build or what to leave alone.

label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - written for training/reference, not a real project or request.
weak_brief: Add a 3D character maker to our existing big app shell. Make it look nice. Ship it tonight.
why_it_fails: It's integration into a large existing app, so layout and scroll regressions are likely (the real Forge pass hit this).
'Look nice' gives no named art direction and no mockups.
No phone-viewport check or screenshot requirement.
No guardrails on shared files or open PRs.

label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - written for training/reference, not a real project or request.
weak_brief: Build a budgeting app. Use React, Redux, Next.js, Prisma, Postgres, Stripe and Plaid. Bank sync is required in v1.
why_it_fails: The stack is over-prescribed and heavy for a first slice.
Plaid and Stripe need secrets and live accounts, so they can't be tested.
No OUT list, and the hardest feature is mandatory.
No tests, docs or evidence asked for.
